entities.summary: Faial da Terra is a civil parish in the municipality of Povoação on the island of São Miguel in the Portuguese archipelago of the Azores. The population in 2011 was 359, in an area of 11.38 km2. It contains the localities Burguete, Faial da Terra, Outeiro, Rebentão, and Sanguinho.
